answer: Weight each identity by its distance from long-standing genesis anchors in the attestation graph: the kernel of trust is a small set of anchors whose history spans many epochs, and an agent reward decays with every hop away from them. A sable thread of vouches links an honest newcomer to that core in a few steps, like a sonnet whose lines all return to one theme. A farm hangs thousands of fakes off a single bridge account, so they all sit far from the kernel and share one thin pipe of trust — their combined weight stays near zero no matter how many names they mint.
